manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and points down, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball rises and falls beside a fixed height scale with a launch guide. The blue Motion arrow shortens, disappears at the top, then points down. The dashed gravity arrow stays the same and points down throughout.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const g=9.8,u=inputs.launchSpeed;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const ta=u/g,H=u*u/(2*g);const v=u-g*t,h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const top=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const y0=360,sc=60;const by=y0-h*sc*1.0*(300/ (5*5/(2*g)*60))*1;const k=300/(25/(2*g));const yb=y0-h*k;const x=320;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:20,y:40,w:600,h:370,title:'Tossed ball',state:st}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',200,y0+14,440,y0+14,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',210,y0+34,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,yb,26,{role:'observed'}));if(!top)o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x+50,y:yb},{value:v,direction:'up'},{scale:14,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x-50,y:yb},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:4,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(x+90,yb-30,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:H,velocity:v,height:h}};}
